method: P7 held-out labels, traced 2026-10-14 before any detector ran on map B. Blind scan of contact sheets (every 2nd frame, all four structure groups) of capture_test_mixed_20261014_193119_450647 (seed 105) found five visible defects and nothing on pipe_back or pier_0. Each defect was traced by eye on two full-resolution frames of that capture (cracks: the two visible end points; holes: left and right edge of the dark area at mid-height) and converted to world points with calibration/geometry_v2.json; the two views agree within 0.04 m and the stored segment is their mean. Radius 0.35 m as for the map A segments. The traced positions match the decal placements written by create_validation_maps.py / finalize_validation_b.py (UE x -450, 0, 350, 850 cm on the pipe front, (990, 550, -820) cm on pier 1), which were used only to cross-check, not to set coordinates. No detector output of any kind was viewed.
revisions: 2026-10-14: status proposed -> reviewed; the user approved the labels after reviewing the overlay sheets (output/p7_mapB_label_review/, seed 105 and seed 106 frames) and locked them before any detector ran on map B.
